items.name: Tax Consultation — Standard
items.description: Structured tax consultation for tax planning, return-readiness review, document planning, and service scoping. Tax advice and filing work remain subject to a signed engagement and professional review.

items.name: Tax Consultation — Executive
items.description: Extended executive consultation for complex individual, business, payroll, compliance, or multi-service planning. Engagement-specific work is separately authorized.

items.name: Individual Tax Return Preparation — 2026
items.description: Base preparation service for an individual federal income-tax return. The signed engagement controls final scope and fee when additional schedules, states, businesses, investments, amendments, representation, or specialty work are required.

items.name: Schedule C / Self-Employed Return — 2026
items.description: Base preparation service for an individual return including one Schedule C business. Additional businesses, states, bookkeeping cleanup, payroll reconciliation, or specialty schedules may change the final engagement fee.

items.name: Business Return Preparation — 2026
items.description: Base business-return preparation service. Entity type, states, bookkeeping condition, ownership complexity, elections, payroll reconciliation, and specialty filings can change the final quoted fee.

items.name: Rental / Investment Return — 2026
items.description: Base preparation service for returns requiring rental-property or investment reporting. Additional properties, brokerage complexity, basis reconstruction, states, or specialty reporting may change the final engagement fee.

items.name: Amended Individual Return — Form 1040-X
items.description: Preparation of an amended individual income-tax return based on verified prior-return records and supporting documentation. Additional years, state amendments, notices, or representation are separate scope items.

items.name: Ross Prime Payroll Management
items.description: Monthly payroll-management service and employer workflow access. Implementation, historical cleanup, amended payroll returns, special projects, third-party fees, and extraordinary filings may be separately billed.

items.name: Ross E-Drive University — Online Driver Education
items.description: Online driver-education enrollment product. Course access, identity checks, progress requirements, completion rules, and regulatory availability remain subject to the applicable program approval and enrollment terms.

items.name: ChatTaxPro Nexus OS — Premium
items.description: Premium monthly software subscription for governed tax-practice operations, workflow, document, case, and service-management capabilities. Regulated provider connections remain separately gated by credentials, authorization, and runtime verification.
features: Provider integrations fail closed until verified

items.name: Rapid Response Audit Defense
items.description: Notice-response, audit-defense, documentation, and escalation services scoped to the taxpayer authorization, issue, tax period, and engagement. Pricing is quote-based because case complexity varies.

items.name: Ross PDF Universal Editor — Business
items.description: Business document editing, OCR, signing, controlled export, and workflow tooling. Commercial pricing is quote-based until the final licensing plan is activated.

items.name: Ross Tax Pro University — Program Enrollment
items.description: Professional tax and operations education enrollment. Program-specific tuition, admissions rules, academic status, and regulated claims remain controlled by the published program catalog and human academic governance.

items.name: Balance Settlement Payment
items.description: Authorized payment toward an existing signed balance or installment agreement. Amount is engagement-specific and must be validated against the signed agreement before a Checkout Session is created.

items.name: SaaS Subscription Settlement
items.description: Authorized settlement payment for an existing signed software subscription balance or negotiated billing arrangement.

items.name: Token Pack Purchase Settlement
items.description: Authorized settlement or negotiated purchase payment for token-pack access under a signed agreement.

items.name: Implementation Setup Fee Settlement
items.description: Authorized payment for an implementation or setup balance documented in a signed service agreement.

items.name: ERO E-file Operations Settlement
items.description: Authorized payment for an ERO/e-file operations balance documented by a signed service agreement. Payment does not itself authorize filing, transmission, or use of IRS credentials.
